_description: Names a RETAINED epoch promised that no frozen compatibility example imports. Read `contracts/compatibility` in `packages/aai-templates/api-contracts-gate.test.ts` for the rule. DENY-list, so a new fixture defaults into being checked, and a RATCHET: entries may be deleted, never added — the spec fails on an entry whose name IS covered, so a stale exemption cannot narrow the gate silently. A name the CURRENT epoch has removed needs no entry; it is forgiven by derivation, because a fixture importing a name that no longer exists could not compile.
